arguments.command:
python3 -c "
# High-grade corporate bond yields
feb_1943 = 2.68
feb_1944 = 2.65
jan_1945 = 2.58

benchmark = 2.60

# Calculate absolute deviations
dev_1943 = abs(feb_1943 - benchmark)
dev_1944 = abs(feb_1944 - benchmark)
dev_1945 = abs(jan_1945 - benchmark)

print(f'February 1943: {feb_1943}%, deviation: {dev_1943}')
print(f'February 1944: {feb_1944}%, deviation: {dev_1944}')
print(f'January 1945: {jan_1945}%, deviation: {dev_1945}')

# Average deviation
avg_dev = (dev_1943 + dev_1944 + dev_1945) / 3
print(f'Average deviation: {avg_dev:.4f}')
print(f'Rounded to 2 decimal places: {round(avg_dev, 2)}')
"
